podcast.body: The band achieved widespread recognition with this album in 1975. Initially intended as the soundtrack for a movie of the same name starring the band and Harvey Keitel, the band chose to release it as a standalone album, fearing the movie's poor quality would negatively impact their music. "It was supposed to be the soundtrack to the movie of the same name in which the band members played a real band in the movie and their manager was played by Harvey Kytel."

This album served as the soundtrack to a largely forgotten Harvey Keitel movie, but it became a world-beating blockbuster for Earth Wind & Fire, standing as their most acclaimed and best-selling LP. It topped the album chart in mid-May 1975, and its lead single, "Shining Star," topped the Hot 100 just one week later. "It topped the album chart in mid-May 1975, and one week later, Shining Star topped the Hot 100."
